Removing 1 Energy Marker from the game is equivalent to switching 1 card from your energy (with the same color as your Leader) to Rest Mode.

FB01-001.name: Son Goku
FB01-001.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Son Goku
back.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] All your Battle Cards with 《Universe 7》 in their special traits get +5000 power.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.

FB01-002.name: Beerus
FB01-002.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[Permanent][Your Turn] This card gets +5000 power.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Beerus
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -10000 power for the turn.

FB01-003.name: Vados
FB01-003.text: [Activate Main][Once per turn] Choose up to 1 of your other Battle Cards with 《Universe 6》 in its special traits and it gets +5000 power for the turn.

FB01-004.name: Whis
FB01-004.text: [Activate Main][Once per turn] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -5000 power for the turn.

FB01-005.name: Master Roshi
FB01-005.text: [Activate Main][Once per turn] Add 1 card from your life to your hand : During this turn, the next time you use an Extra from your hand, reduce the cost by (R).

qa.q: If you activate the [Activate Main] skill on 2 copies of this card, can you use FB01-032 [Tournament of Power Arena] for a cost of 0?
qa.a: No, you can't. You must pay ① cost.

FB01-006.name: Caulifla
FB01-006.text: [On Play] Play up to 1 <Kale> with a cost of 3 from your hand.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you play a [Kale] card with a cost of 3 from your hand in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. Unless specified otherwise, you must play it in Active Mode.

FB01-007.name: Cabba
FB01-007.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB01-008.name: Krillin
FB01-008.text: [When Attacking] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -20000 power for the turn.

FB01-009.name: Kale
FB01-009.text: [When Attacking][Once per turn] If you have a <Caulifla> Battle Card with a cost of 5, switch this card to Active Mode.

FB01-010.name: Saonel
FB01-010.text: [Permanent][Your Turn] If you have 2 or more Battle Cards with 《Namekian》 in their special traits, this card gets +5000 power.

qa.q: Can you include this card itself for "if you have 2 or more Battle Cards with 《Namekian》 in their special traits" in this card's [Permanent] skill?

FB01-012.name: Shin
FB01-012.text: [Permanent][Your Turn] Your Leader with 《God of Destruction》 in its special traits gets +10000 power.

FB01-013.name: Android 17
FB01-013.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When Blocking] This card gets +15000 power for the turn.

FB01-014.name: Android 18
FB01-014.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Krillin> or up to 1 <Android 17> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-015.name: Son Goku
FB01-015.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with 20000 power or less and KO it.

FB01-016.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FB01-016.text: [On Play] Choose all of your opponent's Battle Cards and they get -10000 power for the turn.

FB01-017.name: Great Priest
FB01-017.text:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.
[Permanent][Your Turn] All of your Battle Cards with 《Angel》 in their special traits get +10000 power.

FB01-018.name: Tien Shinhan
FB01-018.text: [Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)

FB01-019.name: Dr. Rota
FB01-019.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -10000 power for the turn.

FB01-020.name: Piccolo
FB01-020.text: [Permanent] All your <Son Gohan : Adolescence> Battle Cards get +5000 power.

FB01-021.name: Hit
FB01-021.text: [When Attacking] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -5000 power for the turn.

qa.q: When this card's [When Attacking] skill activates, can you choose 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and give it -5000 power without adding 1 card from your life to your hand?
qa.a: Yes. You can choose 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and give it -5000 power even if you don't add 1 card from your life to your hand.

FB01-023.name: Beerus
FB01-023.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[On Play] Discard 1 card from your hand : Choose all of your opponent's Battle Cards with 25000 power or less and KO them.

FB01-025.name: Frost
FB01-025.text: [Permanent] Your opponent's Battle Cards with 20000 power or less can't attack.

qa.q: When your opponent's Battle Card with more than 20000 power attacks and then its power is reduced to 20000 or less during the Defense Step, what happens to the attack?
qa.a: The attack proceeds as-is, then you process the Defense Step.

FB01-026.name: Fuwa
FB01-026.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -15000 power for the turn.

FB01-027.name: Vegeta
FB01-027.text: [Permanent][Your Turn] This card gets +10000 power while it's in a battle with an opponent's Battle Card.

FB01-028.name: Botamo
FB01-028.text: [Permanent] This card can't be KO'd in battle.

FB01-030.name: Assemble, Representatives of Universe 7!
FB01-030.text:
[Activate Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Universe 7》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.
[Activate Battle][Your Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +15000 power for the battle.

qa.q: If you pay this card's cost, can you activate its [Activate Main] and [Activate Battle] skills at the same time?
qa.a: No, you can only activate its [Activate Main] or [Activate Battle] skill.

FB01-031.name: Strong Warriors of Universe 6
FB01-031.text:
[Activate Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Universe 6》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.
[Activate Battle][Opponent's Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +15000 power for the battle.

qa.q: If you pay this card's cost, can you activate its [Activate Main] and [Activate Battle] skills at the same time?
qa.a: No, you can only activate its [Activate Main] or [Activate Battle] skill.

FB01-032.name: Tournament of Power Arena
FB01-032.text:
[Field] (This card remains in your Battle Area until you place another [Field].)
[Activate Battle] Switch this card to Rest Mode : Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +5000 power for the battle.

FB01-033.name: Time-Skip
FB01-033.text: [Activate Main] Choose any number of your opponent's Battle Cards that add up to a total power of 35000 or less and KO them.

FB01-034.name: Mafuba
FB01-034.text: [Activate Main] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -15000 power for the turn.

FB01-035.name: Goku Black
FB01-035.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[Permanent][Your Turn] This card gets +5000 power.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Goku Black
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] Place 1 <Zamasu> from your Battle Area at the bottom of your deck : During this turn, the next time you use and play <Goku Black> from your hand, reduce the cost by 2.

FB01-036.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-036.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Trunks : Future
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

qa.q: When the [Activate Main] skill on this card's back side activates, can you choose either your Battle Card or your opponent's Battle Card?
qa.a: Yes, you can choose either player's Battle Card.

FB01-037.name: Goku Black
FB01-037.text: [On Play] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, draw 1 card.

FB01-039.name: Goku Black
FB01-039.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop to your hand.
[When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand.

qa.q: Can you add any type of card from your Drop to your hand for this card's [On Play] skill if the card has a cost of 4 or less?
qa.a: Yes, as long as the card has a cost of 4 or less, can you add any 1 card from your Drop to your hand.

qa.q: Can you use this card's skills to play [Goku Black] with a cost of 6 from your hand if its cost is reduced by 2 after you activate FB01-035 [Goku Black] (Awaken)'s [Activate Main] skill?
qa.a: No, you can't. You can't use this card's skills on cards played by skills. "Using a card" means that you must declare payment of its cost.

qa.q: When this card's [When Attacking] skill activates, can you play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. Unless specified otherwise, you must play it in Active Mode.

FB01-040.name: Gowasu
FB01-040.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Goku Black> or up to 1 <Zamasu> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-041.name: Gowasu
FB01-041.text: [When KO'd] Choose up to 1 card with a cost of 2 or less in the Battle Area and return it to its owner's hand.

qa.q: When this card's [When KO'd] skill activates, can you choose either your card or your opponent's card?
qa.a: Yes, you can choose either player's card.

FB01-042.name: Zamasu
FB01-042.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 1 or less and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.

FB01-043.name: Zamasu
FB01-043.text:
[Permanent] If you have a <Goku Black> Battle Card, this card gains [Blocker].
(Blocker : After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Blocker] in a state where you have a [Goku Black] Battle Card, then the [Goku Black] Battle Card leaves the battle area during the Offense Step, is the activated [Blocker] skill negated?
qa.a: No. Because [Blocker] has already activated and the attack target has switched, it isn't negated.

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Blocker] in a state where you have a [Goku Black] Battle Card, then the [Goku Black] Battle Card is used in a combo and it leaves the battle area during the Defense Step, is the activated [Blocker] skill negated?
qa.a: No. Because [Blocker] has already activated and the attack target has switched, it isn't negated.

FB01-045.name: Shu
FB01-045.text: [Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)

FB01-047.name: Son Goku
FB01-047.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, this card gets +10000 power.

qa.q: During your opponent's turn, if you activate this card's [Blocker] skill in a state where you have 8 cards in your hand, and you use 1 card from your hand in a combo during the Defense Step, you will then have 7 cards in your hand, so does this card's [Permanent] skill apply?
qa.a: Yes, this card's [Permanent] skill will apply as soon as you have 7 cards or less in your hand.

FB01-049.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-049.text: [When Attacking] At the end of the turn, place this card at the bottom of your deck.

FB01-050.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-050.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you choose either your Battle Card or your opponent's Battle Card?
qa.a: Yes, you can choose either player's Battle Card.

FB01-051.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-051.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you choose either your Battle Card or your opponent's Battle Card?
qa.a: Yes, you can choose either player's Battle Card.

FB01-052.name: Trunks : Youth
FB01-052.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

FB01-054.name: Haru/Maki
FB01-054.text: [On Play] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, choose up to 1 of your <Trunks : Future> and it gets +10000 power for the turn.

qa.q: If you use this card from your hand and play it when you have 8 cards in your hand, can you use this card's [On Play] skill to give your [Trunks : Future] +10000 power?
qa.a: Yes. This card's [On Play] skill will activate because you have 7 cards in your hand when the skill activates.

FB01-055.name: Pan
FB01-055.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you discard 2 cards from your hand without drawing 2 cards?
qa.a: No. You must draw 2 cards and discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB01-056.name: Pilaf
FB01-056.text: [On Play] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, add up to 1 card with a cost of 1 or less and 《Earthling》 in its special traits from your Drop to your hand.

qa.q: If you use this card from your hand and play it when you have 8 cards in your hand, when this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you add up to 1 card with a cost of 1 or less and 《Earthling》 in its special traits from your Drop to your hand?
qa.a: Yes. This card's [On Play] skill will activate because you have 7 cards in your hand when the skill activates.

FB01-057.name: Bulma
FB01-057.text: [Activate Main][Once per turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, during this turn, the next time you use an Extra from your hand, reduce the cost by (U).

qa.q: If this card's [Activate Main] skill activates when you have 7 cards in your hand, then your hand increases to 10 cards, do you still reduce the cost by (青) the next time you use an Extra from your hand?
If you activate the [Activate Main] skill on 3 copies of this card, can you use FB01-068 [Sinister Sickle] for a cost of 0?
qa.a: No, you can't. You must pay ② cost.

qa.q: If this card's [Activate Main] skill activates when you have 10 cards in your hand, then your hand is then reduced to 7 cards, do you reduce the cost by (青) the next time you use an Extra from your hand?
qa.a: No, you don't reduce the cost.

FB01-058.name: Vegeta
FB01-058.text: [End of Your Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, switch this card to Active Mode.

FB01-059.name: Vegeta
FB01-059.text: [When Attacking][Once per turn] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 1 or less and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck. Then, switch this card to Active Mode.

qa.q: When this card's [When Attacking] skill activates, can you switch this card to Active Mode without placing 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 1 or less at the bottom of its owner's deck?
qa.a: Yes, you can still switch it to Active Mode.

FB01-060.name: Vegeta
FB01-060.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB01-061.name: Mai : Future
FB01-061.text: [Activate Main][Once per turn] Look at the top card of your deck and place it at the top or bottom of your deck.

FB01-062.name: Mai : Future
FB01-062.text:
[On Play] Add up to 2 cards from your life to your hand.
[Auto][Once per turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, when an opponent's Battle Card is returned to their hand by one of your skills, draw 1 card.

qa.q: Does this card's [Auto] skill activate when an opponent's Battle Card is returned to their hand by one of your skills in a state where you have 8 cards in your hand?
qa.a: No. The trigger conditions aren't met, so it doesn't activate.

qa.q: If an opponent's Battle Card is returned to their hand by one of your skills in a state where you have 7 cards in your hand and 2 copies of this card in play, can you activate the [Auto] skill on both cards one at a time and draw a total of 2 cards?

FB01-063.name: Yajirobe : Future
FB01-063.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB01-064.name: Blade of Despair
FB01-064.text:
[Permanent] If you have a <Zamasu> Battle Card, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Activate Main] Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and return them to their owner's hand.

FB01-065.name: Time Machine
FB01-065.text: [Activate Main] Look at the bottom card of your deck and play up to 1 <Trunks : Future> with a cost of 2. Place any remaining cards at the bottom of your deck.

FB01-066.name: Final Hope Slash
FB01-066.text: [Activate Battle][Your Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

FB01-067.name: Black Kamehameha
FB01-067.text: [Activate Battle][Opponent's Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck and place them at the top or bottom of your deck in any order.

qa.q: Can you use this card's [Activate Battle] skill to place 1 card at the top of your deck and 2 cards at the bottom of your deck?
qa.a: No, you can't. After using this skill to look at 3 cards, you must place all of them at the top or all of them at the bottom of your deck in any order.

FB01-068.name: Sinister Sickle
FB01-068.text: [Activate Main] Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 4 or less and place them at the bottom of their owner's deck in any order.

FB01-069.name: Sinister Shadows
FB01-069.text: [Activate Main] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, choose up to 1 of your <Goku Black> Battle Cards and switch it to Active Mode.

qa.q: If you activate this card's [Activate Main] skill in a state where you have 8 cards in your hand, can you switch up to 1 of your [Goku Black] Battle Cards to Active Mode?
qa.a: Yes, you can switch it to Active Mode.

FB01-070.name: Android 17
FB01-070.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Android 17/Android 18
back.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If you have 6 or more energy, this card gets +10000 power.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.

qa.q: If your energy is reduced from 6 to 3 while this card's back side is attacking, does this card's [Permanent] skill apply?
qa.a: No. It will no longer apply as soon as you have 5 or less energy.

FB01-071.name: Son Gohan : Childhood
FB01-071.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Son Gohan : Childhood
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Battle][Once per turn] Place 1 of your energy in your Drop : This card gets +15000 power for the battle.

FB01-072.name: Krillin
FB01-072.text: [Permanent] Your opponent can't attack <Android 18> in your Battle Area.

FB01-073.name: Android 16
FB01-073.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] If you have <Android 17> and <Android 18> in your Energy Area, this card gets +10000 power.

qa.q: Does this card's [Permanent] skill apply if you have 1 copy of FB01-078 [Android 17/Android 18] in your energy?
qa.a: Yes, it will apply if you have FB01-078 [Android 17/Android 18] in your energy.

FB01-074.name: Android 16
FB01-074.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] Play up to 1 <Son Gohan : Childhood> with a cost of 6 from your Drop.

FB01-075.name: Android 17
FB01-075.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB01-077.name: Android 17
FB01-077.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 <Android 18> with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you play up to 1 [Android 18] with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. Unless specified otherwise, you must play it in Active Mode.

FB01-078.name: Android 17/Android 18
FB01-078.text:
[Double Strike] (This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)
[On Play] Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and KO them.

FB01-079.name: Android 18
FB01-079.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
[When Attacking] If you have 6 or more energy, draw 1 card.

FB01-080.name: Android 18
FB01-080.text: [When Attacking] Place 1 card from your energy in your Drop : Add up to 1 card from your hand to your energy.

FB01-081.name: Android 18
FB01-081.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 <Android 17> with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop.

qa.q: When this card's [On Play] skill activates, can you play up to 1 [Android 17] with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. Unless specified otherwise, you must play it in Active Mode.

FB01-082.name: Android 19
FB01-082.text: [Permanent] If you have 6 or more energy, this card gets +10000 power.

FB01-083.name: Android 20
FB01-083.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Android 17> or up to 1 <Android 18> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-084.name: Android 20
FB01-084.text: [Activate Main] KO this card : Look at 10 cards from the top of your deck and place up to 1 <Dr. Gero's Lab> in your Battle Area. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-086.name: Son Goku
FB01-086.text: [Permanent][Your Turn] If you have <Son Gohan : Childhood> in your Drop, this card gets +10000 power.

FB01-087.name: Son Goku
FB01-087.text: [Auto] When this card is played or when a card is placed in your Drop from your energy, add the top card of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

FB01-088.name: Son Gohan : Childhood
FB01-088.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, then reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Saiyan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-089.name: Son Gohan : Childhood
FB01-089.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 4 or less and KO it.

FB01-090.name: Son Gohan : Childhood
FB01-090.text: [On Play] Add the top card of your deck to your life.

FB01-091.name: Tien Shinhan
FB01-091.text: [On Play] Place 1 card from your life in your Drop : Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 4 or less and KO it.

FB01-092.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-092.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] If your Leader is <Son Gohan : Childhood>, add the top card of your deck to your energy.

FB01-093.name: Trunks : Future
FB01-093.text: [Permanent] This card can't attack your opponent's Leader.

qa.q: Can this card attack if an Active Mode FB01-072 [Krillin] and a Rest Mode [Android 18] are the only cards in your opponent's Battle Area?

FB01-096.name: Vegeta
FB01-096.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or more from your Drop to your energy in Rest Mode.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] Discard 1 card from your hand : Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 2 or less and KO it.

FB01-097.name: Hercule
FB01-097.text:
[Permanent] This card must attack whenever possible.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.

qa.q: What skills are "must attack whenever possible?"
qa.a: Unless this card cannot attack in the first turn of the first attack, etc., if this card in the battle area is active in the main phase, this skill must attack with this card in priority over other actions.

qa.q: What happens if there are two or more of these cards?
qa.a: Attack with one of several of these cards, prioritizing it over other actions.

FB01-098.name: Yamcha
FB01-098.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB01-099.name: Eye Beam
FB01-099.text: [Activate Main] Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 1 or less and KO them.

FB01-100.name: Brother-Sister Combination
FB01-100.text: [Activate Battle][Opponent's Turn] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, if you have 15 or more cards in your Drop, add up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or more from your Drop to your energy in Rest Mode.

qa.q: If this card's [Activate Battle] skill activates when you have 14 cards in your Drop, can you add up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or more from your Drop to your energy in Rest Mode?

FB01-101.name: Instant Kamehameha
FB01-101.text: [Activate Battle] Place 1 of your energy in your Drop : Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +15000 power for the battle.

qa.q: Can you activate this card's [Activate Battle] skill when you have 0 cards in your energy?

FB01-102.name: Dr. Gero's Lab
FB01-102.text:
[Field] (This card remains in your Battle Area until you place another [Field].)
[Activate Main](G), switch this card to Rest Mode : If your Leader is <Android 17>, add up to 1 card with 《Android》 in its special traits from your Drop to your energy.

FB01-103.name: Big Bang Attack
FB01-103.text:
[Permanent] If you have 6 or more energy, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Activate Main] Place 1 of your energy in your Drop : Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 5 or less and KO it.

FB01-104.name: Ginyu
FB01-104.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Ginyu
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once per turn](3), discard 2 cards from your hand : Choose all your Battle Cards with 《Ginyu Force》 in their special traits and switch them to Active Mode.

FB01-105.name: Cooler
FB01-105.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[Permanent][Your Turn] This card gets +5000 power.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Cooler
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main/Battle][Once per turn] Discard 1 card from your hand : Choose up to 1 of your Battle Cards with a cost of 4 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits or 1 of your energy and switch it to Active Mode.

qa.q: When the [Activate Main/Battle] skill on this card's back side activates, does energy switched to Active Mode have to have a cost of 4 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits?
qa.a: No. If you switch energy to Active Mode, you don't reference its special traits.

qa.q: If a card with a cost of 4 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits is chosen for FB01-114 [Guldo]'s skill during your opponent's turn, can the chosen card switch to Active Mode when this card's [Activate Main/Battle] skill activates during the same turn?
qa.a: Yes, you can switch it to Active Mode.

qa.q: If a Battle Card is chosen for FB01-114 [Guldo]'s skill during your opponent's turn and this card's [Activate Main/Battle] skill activates and switches the Battle Card to Active Mode in the same turn, then the card is switched to Rest Mode during your turn, can you use a skill to switch it to Active Mode again?
qa.a: No, it can't switch to Active Mode because of FB01-114 [Guldo]'s skill.

FB01-106.name: Appule
FB01-106.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode : Look at the top card of your deck, then reveal up to 1 card with 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place any remaining cards at the top of your deck.

FB01-107.name: Ginyu
FB01-107.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode : Draw 1 card.

FB01-108.name: Ginyu
FB01-108.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, then reveal up to 1 non-<Ginyu> card with 《Ginyu Force》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-109.name: Ginyu
FB01-109.text: [On Play] If you have 3 or more Battle Cards with 《Frieza's Army》 in their special traits, switch up to 2 of your energy to Active Mode. Then, you can't play <Ginyu> for the turn.

qa.q: If you have 2 or fewer cards with 《Frieza's Army》 in their special traits after playing this card, can you then play [Ginyu]?

FB01-110.name: Ginyu
FB01-110.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 Extra with 《Ginyu Force》 in its special traits from your Drop to your hand.

FB01-111.name: Cui
FB01-111.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and switch it to Rest Mode.

FB01-113.name: Cooler
FB01-113.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When Attacking]/[When Blocking] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and switch it to Rest Mode. Then, if that card has a cost of 2 or less, KO it.

FB01-114.name: Guldo
FB01-114.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode : Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Rest Mode Battle Cards and it can't switch to Active Mode during your opponent's next turn.

qa.q:
If you activate this card's [Activate Main] skill and choose your opponent's Rest Mode Battle Card,
can the chosen card then switch to Active Mode when FB01-105 [Cooler] (Awaken)'s [Activate Main/Battle] skill activates during the same turn?

If you activate this card's [Activate Main] skill and choose your opponent's Rest Mode Battle Card,
the chosen card then switches to Active Mode when FB01-105 [Cooler] (Awaken)'s [Activate Main/Battle] skill activates during the same turn, and that card is switched to Rest Mode during your opponent's next turn from an attack, etc., can that card switch to Active Mode again when FB01-105 [Cooler]'s [Activate Main/Battle] skill activates?

FB01-116.name: Zarbon
FB01-116.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, then reveal up to 1 card that includes <Frieza> in its card name and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FB01-117.name: Salza
FB01-117.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB01-118.name: Salza
FB01-118.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode : Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and 《Cooler's Armored Squadron》 in its special traits from your hand.

qa.q: When this card's [Activate Main] skill activates, can you play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and 《Cooler's Armored Squadron》 in its special traits from your hand in Rest Mode?
qa.a: No, you can't. Unless specified otherwise, you must play it in Active Mode.

FB01-119.name: Jeice
FB01-119.text: [Permanent][Your Turn] If you have a total of 3 or more cards with 《Ginyu Force》 in their special traits among your Leader and Battle Cards, this card gets +5000 power.

qa.q: Can you include this card itself for "if you have a total of 3 or more cards with 《Ginyu Force》 in their special traits among your Leader and Battle Cards" in this card's [Permanent] skill?

FB01-120.name: Sui
FB01-120.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] This card gets +10000 power.

FB01-121.name: Chilled
FB01-121.text: [Permanent][Opponent's Turn] All your Battle Cards with 《Frieza Clan》 in their special traits get +5000 power.

FB01-122.name: Dore
FB01-122.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 of your Battle Cards with 《Cooler's Armored Squadron》 in its special traits and switch it to Active Mode.

FB01-123.name: Dodoria

FB01-124.name: Neiz

qa.q: When exactly is the timing for "when your Battle Card with a cost of 5 or more is removed from the Battle Area by your opponent" in this card's [Auto] skill?
qa.a:
The following timings: ① When it's KO'd in battle after an opponent's attack (an attack by a card whose master is your opponent)
② When it's removed from the Battle Area by an opponent's skill (a skill on a card whose master is your opponent)

qa.q: Does this card's [Auto] skill activate when your Battle Card with a cost of 5 or more has its power reduced to 0 or less by an opponent's skill and is placed into its owner's Drop?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate. In such cases, the Battle Card is placed into its owner's Drop according to the rules, therefore this skill's trigger conditions aren't met.

FB03-053.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Piccolo
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Auto][Once per turn] When this card's attack deals damage, if you have 8 or more energy, switch this card to Active Mode.

qa.q: If your opponent activates the [Activate Battle] skill on FB03-009 <Jiren> and they take damage during the Defense Step when you use this card's back side to attack, does this card's [Auto] skill activate?
qa.a: No, it doesn't activate. This card's [Auto] skill will only activate when this card wins a battle and deals damage.

FB03-054.name: King Yemma
FB03-054.text: [On Play] If you have 6 or more energy, play up to 1 skill-less Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less from your Drop.

FB03-055.name: Kami
FB03-055.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Piccolo> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of its owner's deck in a random order.

FB03-056.name: Master Roshi
FB03-056.text: [On Play] Return 1 Extra from your energy to your hand : Add the top card of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

FB03-057.name: North Kai
FB03-057.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When Blocking] If you have 6 or more energy, add up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or 6 from your Drop to your hand.

FB03-058.name: Gregory
FB03-058.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] Play up to 1 <North Kai> with a cost of 3 from your hand.

FB03-059.name: Android 17
FB03-059.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 [Field] with 《Android》 in its special traits in your Battle Area and switch it to Active Mode.

FB03-060.name: Cell
FB03-060.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[When KO'd] Choose up to 1 card with a cost of 4 or less in a Battle Area and add it to its owner's energy in Rest Mode.

FB03-061.name: Cell
FB03-061.text:
[On Play][Your Turn] If your Leader is <Cell>, choose all cards with costs of 6 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and add them to their owner's energy in Rest Mode.
[When KO'd] Place 1 card from your energy in its owner's Drop : Play this card from your Drop in Rest Mode.

qa.a: Yes. You must choose all cards in the Battle Areas.

FB03-064.name: Son Goku
FB03-064.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play/When KO'd] Draw 1 card. Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to your energy.

FB03-066.name: Son Gohan : Youth
FB03-066.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)

[When KO'd] Play up to 1 <Gregory> with a cost of 2 from your hand.

FB03-070.name: Piccolo
FB03-070.text:
[When KO'd] Add the top card of your deck to your life.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] If you have 8 or more energy, during this turn, the next time you use an Extra with a cost of 5 or less from your hand, you don't have to pay the cost.

If this card's [Activate Main] skill activates in a state where you have 8 or more energy, can you choose to pay the cost for the Extra?

qa.a: You choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking at the fronts of the cards (with the card information remaining hidden).

qa.q: What happens to the card after being revealed by this skill?
qa.a: After the card is revealed, it's returned to a state where only your opponent can see its front (to a hidden state).

FB03-082.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and 《Wicked Soul》 in its special traits from your hand.

qa.a: It means if you removed an energy marker to pay the skill cost for this skill.

FB03-127.text: [Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

qa.a: You place 1 energy marker into your Energy Area.

FB07-020.text: [Permanent] This card can't attack your opponent's Leader.

FB07-021.name: Vegeta : DA
FB07-021.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2) : <Vegeta : DA> or <Vegeta (Mini) : DA>
[On Play] If your Leader has <DA> in its card name, draw 1 card. Then, this card can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills until the end of your opponent's next turn.

FB07-022.name: Powered up Majin Duu : DA
FB07-022.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If you have a card with <DA> in its card name and [Evolve] in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 2.
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -5000 power for the turn.

FB07-023.name: Evolving to Super Saiyan 4
FB07-023.text: [Activate Battle] Your card that's in a battle gets +15000 power for the battle. Then, if you have a card with <DA> in its card name and [Evolve] in your Battle Area, your card that's in a battle gets +10000 power for the battle.

FB07-024.name: Showdown in the Demon King Palace
FB07-024.text: [Activate Main] If your Leader has <DA> in its card name, choose up to 1 card with <DA> in its card name and [Evolve] in your Battle Area. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area with power less than or equal to the card chosen by this skill and KO it.

FB07-025.name: Syn Shenron
FB07-025.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 6 or less and you have 7 or more cards with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits in your Drop, flip this card over.

back.name: Omega Shenron
back.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] When you would pay the cost of an Extra with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits from your hand, once per turn, you may place the same number of cards with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits as that card's cost from your Drop at the bottom of your deck in a random order instead.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.

qa.q: I paid the cost of an Extra with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits in my hand as normal while this card was awakened. Afterwards, when paying the cost of another Extra with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits in my hand during the same turn, can I use this card's [Permanent] skill to pay the cost of that Extra using cards from my Drop instead?

FB07-026.name: Syn Shenron
FB07-026.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB07-027.name: Syn Shenron
FB07-027.text:
[On Play] Place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main] Place 7 cards with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits from your Drop at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order, then return this card from the Battle Area to its owner's hand : If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, play up to 1 <Omega Shenron> from your hand.

qa.q: If I have less than 7 cards with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits in my Drop, can I still place the cards I do have from my Drop at the bottom of my deck and return this card to my hand to activate the [Activate Main] skill of this card?
qa.a: No, you can't. To activate a skill with a skill cost, you must pay the entire skill cost. You can't pay only part of a skill cost.

FB07-028.name: Rage Shenron
FB07-028.text:
[On Play] Place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main] Place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, play up to 1 <Rage Shenron> with a cost of 4 from your Drop.

FB07-029.name: Rage Shenron
FB07-029.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB07-030.name: Black Smoke Dragon
FB07-030.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 non-<Black Smoke Dragon> card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest into its owner's Drop.

FB07-031.name: Gotenks
FB07-031.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.
[Activate Main](1), place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : If your Leader is <Son Gohan : Adolescence>, play up to 1 <Gotenks> with a cost of 4 from your hand.

FB07-032.name: Eis Shenron
FB07-032.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-033.name: Nuova Shenron
FB07-033.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and return it to its owner's hand.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and return it to its owner's hand" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-034.name: Nuova Shenron
FB07-034.text:
[When KO'd] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area with a cost of 4 or less and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.
[Activate Main][Once per turn] Place the top 4 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop : Switch this card to Active Mode.

FB07-035.name: Omega Shenron
FB07-035.text:
[Permanent] If you have 7 or more cards in your Drop, this card can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills.
[On Play] Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck, reveal any number of Extras with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits and add them to your hand. Place the rest into its owner's Drop.

qa.q: When using this card's [On Play] skill, can I place one or more Extras with 《Shadow Dragon》 in their special traits from among the 7 cards I looked at into my Drop without revealing them?

FB07-036.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FB07-036.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If you have 10 or more cards in your Drop, this card gets +10000 power.
[When Attacking] If your Leader is <Son Gohan : Adolescence>, add up to 1 <Gotenks> or <Piccolo> with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop to your hand.

FB07-037.name: Naturon Shenron
FB07-037.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
[Activate Main] Place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, play up to 1 <Naturon Shenron> with a cost of 3 from your Drop.

FB07-038.name: Naturon Shenron
FB07-038.text: [On Play] If you have 7 or more cards in your Drop, draw 1 card.

FB07-039.name: Trunks : Future
FB07-039.text:
[On Play] Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less from your hand.
[When Attacking] If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, choose all Battle Cards in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce their costs by 2 for the turn. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less in a Battle Area and return it to its owner's hand.

FB07-040.name: Vegito
FB07-040.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, place the top 3 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main](1), place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : If your Leader is <Vegito>, play up to 1 <Vegito> with a cost of 4 from your Drop.

FB07-041.name: Haze Shenron
FB07-041.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, look at 2 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest into its owner's Drop.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, look at 2 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest into its owner's Drop" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-042.name: Oceanus Shenron
FB07-042.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area with a cost of 1 or less and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.
[Activate Main] Place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : If your Leader has 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits, play up to 1 <Oceanus Shenron> with a cost of 3 from your Drop.

FB07-043.name: Oceanus Shenron
FB07-043.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] Place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, this card can't attack for the turn.

qa.q: Can I choose not to resolve this card's [On Play] skill in order to attack with it during the turn it is played?

FB07-044.name: Whirlwind Spin
FB07-044.text:
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] When you would pay the cost of this card in your hand, you may discard 1 card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits other than this card from your hand instead.
[Activate Battle] Your card that's in a battle gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, choose all Battle Cards with costs of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and place them at the bottom of their owner's deck.

qa.q: My opponent used their Battle Card with a cost of 1 to attack my Leader. If I activate this card during the Defense Step after the Offense Step has ended, what will happen to my opponent's Battle Card?
qa.a: Your opponent's card will be placed at the bottom of its owner's deck. Then, since there are no attacking cards remaining, the battle will progress to the Battle End Step.

FB07-045.name: Dragon Thunder
FB07-045.text: [Activate Main] Draw 2 cards. Then, your opponent can't activate [Blocker] for the turn.

qa.q: I used my Leader to attack my opponent's Leader after using this card. Although my opponent can't activate [Blocker], can they still pay a skill cost that requires them to rest a card with [Blocker]?

FB07-046.name: Burst Attack
FB07-046.text: [Activate Main] During this turn, when your card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits attacks an opponent's Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less, place the attacked card at the bottom of its owner's deck.

qa.q: After using this card, I attacked my opponent's Battle Card with a cost of 5 using a card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits. If my opponent uses the [Auto] skill of their awakened FB07-049 <Piccolo : SH> to change the target of the attack to their Battle Card with a cost of 3, in what order will this resolve?
qa.a: First, your opponent's Battle Card with a cost of 5 will be placed at the bottom of their deck due to this card's [Activate Main] skill. Your opponent's Battle Card with a cost of 3 will then become the guard card based on the [Auto] skill of their FB07-049 <Piccolo : SH>. The new guard card will not be affected by the [Activate Main] skill of this card as it has already resolved.

FB07-047.name: Minus Energy Power Ball
FB07-047.text:
[Activate Main] Choose up to 1 <Omega Shenron> in your Battle Area and switch it to Active Mode. Then, if you have 7 or more cards in your Drop, the card chosen by this skill gains [Double Strike] and +20000 power for the turn.
([Double Strike] : This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)

qa.q: I paid the cost and activated this card from my hand when I had 6 cards in my Drop. Do I still resolve the "Then, if you have 7 or more cards in your Drop, the card chosen by this skill gains [Double Strike] and +20000 power for the turn" part of this card's [Activate Main] skill?

I activated this card from my hand using the [Permanent] skill of my awakened FB07-025 <Omega Shenron> to return 7 cards from my Drop to the bottom of your deck when I had 13 cards in my Drop. Do I still resolve the "Then, if you have 7 or more cards in your Drop, the card chosen by this skill gains [Double Strike] and +20000 power for the turn" part of this card's [Activate Main] skill?

FB07-048.name: Great. I'm In Time.
FB07-048.text: [Activate Main] Place the top 3 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop : Draw 1 card. Then, play up to 2 Battle Cards with different card names, 《Saiyan》 in their special traits, and a total cost of 6 or less from your Drop.

qa.q: Can I use this card's [Activate Main] skill to play FB03-037 <Son Goten> and FB03-048 <Mighty Mask>?

FB07-049.name: Piccolo : SH
FB07-049.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Piccolo : SH
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Auto] When an opponent's card attacks, you may choose 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or more and <SH> in its card name in your Battle Area. If you do, switch the attack target to the chosen card. Then, this skill can't activate for the turn.

qa.q: When my opponent's card attacks, can I use the [Auto] skill on this card's awakened side to choose an Active Mode Battle Card and make it the attack target?

When my opponent's card attacks, I decided not to choose 1 of my Battle Cards for the [Auto] skill on this card's awakened side. Will the "Then, this skill can't activate for the turn" part of the skill still apply?

When my opponent's card attacks, can I first activate the [Blocker] and [When Blocking] skills of FB03-057 <North Kai>, then use the [Auto] skill on the awakened side of this card to change the attack target?

My opponent used FB07-046 <Burst Attack> before attacking my Battle Card with a cost of 5 using a card with 《Shadow Dragon》 in its special traits. If I want to use the [Auto] skill on the awakened side of this card to choose my Battle Card with a cost of 3 and change the attack target to it. In what order will this resolve?
qa.a: First, the Battle Card with a cost of 5 will be placed at the bottom of your deck due to the [Activate Main] skill of your opponent's FB07-046 <Burst Attack>. Then, the Battle Card with a cost of 3 will become the guard card due to this card's [Auto] skill. The new guard card will not be affected by the [Activate Main] skill of FB07-046 <Burst Attack> as it has already resolved.

FB07-050.name: Gamma 1 : SH
FB07-050.text: [On Play] Discard 1 card with <SH> in its card name from your hand : If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, draw 2 cards.

FB07-051.name: Gamma 1 : SH/Gamma 2 : SH
FB07-051.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it. Then, your Leader with <SH> in its card name gets +5000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

qa.q: If my opponent does not have a Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less in their Battle Area, can I still resolve the "Then, your Leader with <SH> in its card name gets +5000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-052.name: Gamma 2 : SH
FB07-052.text:
[Permanent] If you have 6 or more energy, this card in a Battle Area gets +15000 power.
[End of Your Turn] KO this card in a Battle Area. Then, if your Leader has <SH> in its card name, add the top card of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

qa.q: I don't want to KO this card. Do I always have to KO this card when its [End of Your Turn] skill activates?
qa.a: Yes. Provided there is no influence from other effects, the effect of this [End of Your Turn] skill will always occur.

FB07-053.name: Krillin : SH
FB07-053.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name and you have 6 or more energy, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and it can't attack until the end of your opponent's next turn.

FB07-054.name: Gotenks : SH
FB07-054.text: [When KO'd] Place 1 card from your energy in its owner's Drop : Add the top card of your deck to your energy.

FB07-055.name: Android 18 : SH
FB07-055.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name and you have 6 or more energy, add up to 1 green non-<Android 18 : SH> card with a cost of 3 or less and <SH> in its card name from your Drop to your hand.

FB07-056.name: Son Gohan : SH
FB07-056.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name and you have 6 or more energy, this card in a Battle Area gets +10000 power.

FB07-057.name: Son Gohan : SH
FB07-057.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB07-058.name: Son Gohan : SH
FB07-058.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, add up to 2 cards with costs of 3 or more and <SH> in their card names from your Drop to your energy in Rest Mode.

FB07-060.name: Cheelai : BR
FB07-060.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Broly : BR> and you have 4 energy, play up to 1 <Broly : BR> with a cost of 4 from your hand.

FB07-061.name: Dende : SH
FB07-061.text: [On Play] If you have 6 or more energy, choose up to 1 <Piccolo : SH> in your Leader Area or Battle Area and it gets +10000 power for the turn.

FB07-062.name: Trunks : SH
FB07-062.text: [On Play] If you have 6 or more energy, choose up to 1 <Piccolo : SH> in your Leader Area or Battle Area and it gets +10000 power for the turn.

FB07-063.name: Pan : SH
FB07-063.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with <SH> in its card name and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

FB07-065.name: Piccolo : SH
FB07-065.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, add up to 1 card with a cost of 3 or more from your Drop to your energy.
[When KO'd] Add up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and <SH> in its card name from your Drop to your hand.

FB07-066.name: Piccolo : SH
FB07-066.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, until the end of your opponent's next turn, this card can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills and it gets +10000 power.

FB07-067.name: Bulma : SH
FB07-067.text: [Activate Main](1), switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode : If you have 6 or more energy, play up to 1 skill-less Battle Card with a cost of 3 and <SH> in its card name from your hand.

FB07-068.name: Broly
FB07-068.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If your Leader is <Broly> and you have <Paragus> in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 4.
[On Play] Choose each <Paragus> in the Battle Areas and KO them. Then, add the top 2 cards of your deck to your energy in Rest Mode.

qa.q: Do I have to choose all <Paragus> cards in both players' Battle Areas with this card's [On Play] skill?
qa.a: Yes. You must choose and KO all <Paragus> cards in both player's Battle Areas.

FB07-069.name: Broly : BR
FB07-069.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If your Leader is <Broly : BR>, add 3 to the cost of this card in a Battle Area.
[When Attacking][Once per turn] If you don't have another <Broly : BR> in your Battle Area, switch this card in a Battle Area to Active Mode.

FB07-070.name: United Front
FB07-070.text: [Activate Battle][Opponent's Turn] If there is a Battle Card with a cost of 5 or more and <SH> in its card name in your Battle Area, your card that's in a battle gets +30000 power for the battle.

FB07-071.name: Explosive Rage
FB07-071.text:
[Activate Main] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, choose up to 1 <Son Gohan : SH> in your Battle Area and it gains [Double Strike] and +10000 power for the turn.
([Double Strike] : This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)

FB07-072.name: Piccolo's Giantification
FB07-072.text: [Activate Main] Choose up to 1 <Piccolo : SH> with a cost of 5 in your Battle Area and it can't be removed from the Battle Area by the skills of your opponent's Battle Cards until the end of your opponent's next turn.

FB07-073.name: Frieza
FB07-073.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Golden Frieza
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[End of Your Turn](1) : Reveal the top card of your life, and if the revealed card is a Battle Card with a cost of 6 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, you may play it.

FB07-074.name: Ginyu
FB07-074.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] Add 1 card from your life to your hand : Add up to 1 card from your hand to your life.

FB07-075.name: Cabira/Tobi
FB07-075.text: [Permanent] If you have a Rest Mode <Chilled> in your Battle Area, this card gets +5000 power.

FB07-076.name: Cui
FB07-076.text: [On Play] Add 1 card from your life to your hand : If this card is in Active Mode, add up to 1 card from your hand to your life.

FB07-077.name: Cooler
FB07-077.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and switch it to Rest Mode.
[When Attacking] If your Leader has 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, draw 1 card.

FB07-078.name: Cooler
FB07-078.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB07-079.name: Golden Frieza
FB07-079.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Rest Mode Battle Cards in a Battle Area and up to 1 of their Rest Mode energy and they can't switch to Active Mode during your opponent's next turn.

FB07-080.name: King Cold
FB07-080.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, look at 4 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

qa.q: If my Leader doesn't have 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, look at 4 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-081.name: Third Eye Gomah : DA
FB07-081.text:
[Permanent] This card's name is also treated as <King Gomah : DA> in all areas.
[On Play] If your Leader is <King Gomah : DA>, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 [Field] with a cost of 2 or less that includes 《Demon Realm》 or 《Demon World》 in its special traits from your hand.

qa.q: If my Leader is not <King Gomah : DA>, do I still resolve the "Then, play up to 1 [Field] with a cost of 2 or less that includes 《Demon Realm》 or 《Demon World》 in its special traits from your hand" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-082.name: Zarbon
FB07-082.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <Frieza> in its card name, draw 1 card.

FB07-083.name: Giant Gomah : DA
FB07-083.text:
[Permanent] This card's name is also treated as <King Gomah : DA> in all areas.
[On Play] Discard 2 cards from your hand : Draw 1 card for each type of card with [Field] that includes 《Demon Realm》 or 《Demon World》 in its special traits in your Drop.
[Activate Main] Place this card in a Battle Area into its owner's Drop : Play up to 1 <King Gomah : DA> with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop.

qa.q: If I have 2 copies of FB06-092 <Demon King Palace> and 1 copy of FB06-093 <Witch's Abode> in my Drop for a total of 3 cards, how many cards can I draw with this card's [On Play] skill?

I only have 1 card in my Drop, FB06-092 <Demon King Palace>. If I discard FB06-093 <Witch's Abode> and FB06-094 <Planet of Mega> to pay the skill cost of this card's [On Play] skill, how many cards can I draw with this skill?

FB07-084.name: Tagoma
FB07-084.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode : If your Leader has <Frieza> in its card name, add 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to your life.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have <Frieza> in its card name, do I still resolve the "Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to your life" part of this card's [Activate Main] skill?

FB07-085.name: Chilled
FB07-085.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 from your hand.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Frieza Clan》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 from your hand" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-086.name: Degesu : DA
FB07-086.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <King Gomah : DA>, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card that includes 《Demon Realm》 or 《Demon World》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.

qa.q: If my Leader is not <King Gomah : DA>, do I still resolve the "Then, discard 1 card from your hand" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

FB07-087.name: Dodoria
FB07-087.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] Add 1 card from your life to your hand : If this card is in Active Mode, add up to 1 card from your hand to your life.

FB07-088.name: Frieza
FB07-088.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <Frieza> in its card name and this card is in Active Mode, add 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to your life.
