FB11-002.name: Great Saiyaman
FB11-002.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is a 《Saiyan》-only <Son Goku>, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 and 《Saiyan》 or 《Earthling》 in its special traits from your hand. Then, during this turn, reduce the cost of the next [Evolve] skill you activate from your hand by (2).
[When Attacking] This card gets +5000 power for the battle.

FB11-003.name: Great Saiyaman 2
FB11-003.text: [When Attacking] If you have a <Son Gohan : Adolescence> or <Great Saiyaman>―both with a cost of 3 or more―in your Battle Area, choose up to 1 <Son Gohan : Adolescence> or up to 1 card with <Great Saiyaman> in its card name in your Battle Area and it gets +10000 power for the turn.

FB11-004.name: Great Saiyaman 2
FB11-004.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB11-005.name: Gogeta : BR
FB11-005.text:
[Fusion Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified cards in a Battle Area in Active Mode)(0): <Son Goku : BR> and <Vegeta : BR> with equal power of 20000 or more.
[Permanent] This card in your Battle Area and your <Gogeta : BR> Leader get +15000 power while they are in a battle with an opponent's card with an original power of 30000.

FB11-008.name: Son Goku
FB11-008.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB11-009.name: Son Goku
FB11-009.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku>, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Son Goku> or card with 《Earthling》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

FB11-010.name: Son Goku
FB11-010.text: [On Play] Choose all Battle Cards with costs of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and they get -10000 power for the turn.

FB11-011.name: Son Goku
FB11-011.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Son Goku>
[Auto][Once Per Turn] When this card wins a battle, look at 2 cards from the top of your deck and add 1 card to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of its owner's deck.

qa.q: I attacked my opponent's Leader with this card and inflicted damage. Will this card's [Auto] skill activate?
I attacked my opponent's Battle Card with this card and KO'd it. Will this card's [Auto] skill activate?
This card is attacked by my opponent's card with 30000 power, and my opponent didn't combo, while I used a card with 5000 combo power in a combo. Will this card's [Auto] skill activate?
I attacked my opponent's Leader with this card and this card won the battle. Will this card's [Auto] skill activate before or after my opponent receives damage from the battle?
qa.a: It will activate after your opponent receives damage from the battle.

qa.q: I attacked my opponent's FB10-009 <Suno> with this card and this card won the battle. Which will activate first, this card's [Auto] skill or my opponent's FB10-009 <Suno> [When KO'd] skill?
qa.a: This card's [Auto] skill will activate first. The conditions for activating both skills are met at the same time, but the turn player's skill activates first.

qa.q: I attacked my opponent's FB05-009 <Tamagami Number Three : DA> with this card and won the battle, but the FB05-009 <Tamagami Number Three : DA> was not KO'd due to its [Permanent] skill. Will this card's [Auto] skill activate?

This card was attacked by my opponent's card with 100000 power, and my opponent didn't combo, while I used FB02-033 <Saved by a Barrier> and chose this card. This card was not KO'd thanks to the FB02-033 <Saved by a Barrier> skill but will this card's [Auto] skill activate?

FB11-012.name: Son Goku : BR
FB11-012.text:
[On Play](1): If your Leader is <Gogeta : BR>, play up to 1 <Vegeta : BR> with a cost of 2 or less from your hand in Rest Mode.

[When Attacking] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

FB11-013.name: Son Goten
FB11-013.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -5000 power for the turn.

FB11-014.name: Son Goten
FB11-014.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Son Goten>
[On Play] Play up to 1 <Trunks : Youth> with a cost of 2 or less from your hand.

FB11-016.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FB11-016.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2): <Son Gohan : Adolescence> or <Great Saiyaman>
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with an original power of 10000 and 《Earthling》 in its special traits in your Battle Area, and switch this card and the chosen card to Active Mode.

FB11-017.name: Trunks : Youth
FB11-017.text:
[Activate Battle](1), place this card from a Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If your Leader is <Son Goku>, your card with an original power of 30000 or more and [Evolve] that's in a battle gains [Double Strike] and +5000 power for the battle.
([Double Strike]: This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)

FB11-018.name: Trunks : Youth
FB11-018.text: [Activate Main] Place this card and 1 <Son Goten>―both with 20000 power―from your Battle Area into their owner's Drop: Play up to 1 <Gotenks> with a cost of 4 from your hand.

FB11-019.name: Videl
FB11-019.text: [Activate Main] Place this card from a Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If your Leader is awakened, play up to 1 <Great Saiyaman 2> with a cost of 1 from your hand.

FB11-020.name: Bulma
FB11-020.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -5000 power for the turn.

[Activate Main] Place this card from a Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If your Leader is <Son Goku> and you have a card with [Evolve] in your Battle Area, choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -10000 power for the turn.

FB11-022.name: Vegeta
FB11-022.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Vegeta>
[When Attacking] Add 1 card from your life to your hand: This card gains [Critical] and +5000 power for the battle.
([Critical]: When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB11-023.name: Vegeta : BR
FB11-023.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] This card in a Battle Area gets +5000 power.
[On Play] Choose 1 of your awakened <Gogeta : BR> Leaders and its original power becomes 25000 until the end of your opponent's next turn.

FB11-024.name: Entrusted Sword
FB11-024.text: [Activate Main] If your Leader is awakened and you have a <Trunks : Youth> in your Battle Area, draw 2 cards.

FB11-025.name: Trunks : Future/Son Gohan : Future
FB11-025.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) If you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

back.name: Trunks : Future
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with <Future> in its card name in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki]. Then, return up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less and <Future> in its card name in your Battle Area to its owner's hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-026.name: Android 17
FB11-026.text: [On Play] If your Battle Card was removed from a Battle Area by one of your skills during this turn, draw 2 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.

FB11-027.name: Android 18
FB11-027.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.

FB11-029.name: Son Goku
FB11-029.text:
[Permanent] If you have 12 or more cards in your Drop, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 2.
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area, place it at the bottom of its owner's deck, and discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, you can't play <Son Goku> with a cost of 3 or less for the turn.

FB11-030.name: Son Gohan : Future
FB11-030.text:
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-031.name: Son Gohan : Future
FB11-031.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB11-032.name: Son Gohan : Future
FB11-032.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with <Future> in its card name in your Battle Area and it gets +2 [Ki].
[Auto][Once Per Turn] If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, when your Battle Card is removed from the Battle Area by one of your skills, draw 1 card.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I used my FB11-025 <Trunks : Future>'s [Activate Main] skill on its awakened side to return this card to my hand. Can I draw 1 card with this card's [Auto] skill?

FB11-033.name: Son Gohan : Future
FB11-033.text:
[On Play] Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and <Future> in its card name from your hand. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki].
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce its cost by 1 for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-034.name: Trunks : Future
FB11-034.text:
[Activate Main] Place this card with 3 or more [Ki] at the bottom of its owner's deck: If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, play up to 1 <Trunks : Future> with a cost of 4 or less from your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-035.name: Trunks : Future
FB11-035.text:
[On Play] This card gets +1 [Ki].
[Activate Main] Remove 2 or more [Ki] from this card and place this card at the bottom of its owner's deck: If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, draw 1 card and play up to 1 <Trunks : Future> with a cost 1 greater than the number of [Ki] removed by this skill from your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I removed 2 [Ki] for the skill cost of this card's [Activate: Main] skill and placed this card at the bottom of my deck. Can I play a <Trunks: Future> with a cost of 2 from my hand with this skill's effect?
qa.a: No, you can't. In this case, you can only play a <Trunks: Future> with a cost of exactly 3.

FB11-036.name: Trunks : Future
FB11-036.text:
[When Attacking] Choose up to 2 Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and return them to their owner's hand.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Reduce the [Ki] of your Battle Area by 1: Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and reduce its cost by 3 for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-037.name: Trunks : Future
FB11-037.text:
[On Play] Choose all Battle Cards in your Battle Area with 《Saiyan》 or 《Earthling》 in their special traits other than this card and they get +1 [Ki].
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] Remove a total of all 1 or more [Ki] from your Battle Area: Switch this card to Active Mode and this card gets +5000 power for the turn for each [Ki] removed by this skill.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-039.name: Frieza
FB11-039.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Tournament of Power》 in its special traits, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Tournament of Power》 in its special traits other than <Frieza> and add it to your hand. Place the rest into their owner's Drop. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.

FB11-040.name: Bulma : Future
FB11-040.text:
[Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode: If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, draw 1 card and discard 1 card from your hand. Then, choose up to 1 of your Battle Cards with 1 or more [Ki] and <Future> in its card name and it gets +2 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-041.name: Bulma : Future
FB11-041.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Trunks : Future> and your Battle Card was removed from a Battle Area by one of your skills during this turn, look at the bottom card of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Trunks : Future> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of its owner's deck.

FB11-042.name: Vegeta
FB11-042.text:
[When Attacking] If you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, this card gets +5000 power for the battle.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-043.name: Vegeta
FB11-043.text: [When Attacking] Discard 1 card from your hand, then place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop: If your Leader has 《Tournament of Power》 in its special traits, draw 1 card.

FB11-044.name: Mai : Future
FB11-044.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB11-045.name: Mai : Future
FB11-045.text:
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with <Future> in its card name in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki]. Then, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-046.name: Mai : Future
FB11-046.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Trunks : Future>, look at 4 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 Battle Card with <Future> in its card name and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

FB11-047.name: Yajirobe : Future
FB11-047.text: [Permanent] If this card would be removed from a Battle Area by your opponent's skill, return this card to its owner's hand instead.

qa.q: My Leader is <Trunks: Future>. Instead of being KO'd by my opponent's skill, this card was returned to my hand by this card's [Permanent] skill. In this case, does the "If your Leader is <Trunks: Future>, when your Battle Card is removed from the Battle Area by one of your skills" part of the FB11-032 <Son Gohan : Future> [Auto] skill apply?

FB11-048.name: Desperate Strike
FB11-048.text: [Activate Battle][Your Turn] Your card that's in a battle gets +15000 power for the battle. Then, if your Battle Card was removed from a Battle Area by one of your skills during this turn, your card that's in a battle gets +10000 power for the battle.

FB11-049.name: Goku Black
FB11-049.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) If you have <Goku Black> or <Zamasu> in your Battle Area and you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

back.name: Goku Black
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 2 cards and discard 1 card from your hand. Then, choose up to 1 <Goku Black> and up to 1 <Zamasu> in your Battle Area and they get +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-050.name: Whis
FB11-050.text:
[On Play] If you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-051.name: Goku Black
FB11-051.text:
[When Attacking] If your Leader is <Goku Black> and any [Ki] have been removed from your Battle Area during this turn, this card gets +10000 power for the battle.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-053.name: Goku Black
FB11-053.text:
[Permanent] Add 1 to the cost of this card for each [Ki] this card has.
[On Play] This card gets +2 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-054.name: Goku Black
FB11-054.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Goku Black>, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Goku Black> or <Zamasu> and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.
[When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-055.name: Goku Black
FB11-055.text:
[When Attacking] This card gets +1 [Ki].
[Activate Main] Choose 1 <Goku Black> with a cost of 3 and 20000 power from your energy, and reduce the total [Ki] of your Battle Area by 2: Add this card in a Battle Area to your energy in Rest Mode. Then, play the card chosen by this skill with its base skills negated for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-056.name: Goku Black
FB11-056.text:
[When Attacking] This card gets +5000 power for the battle.
[Activate Main] Choose 1 <Goku Black> with a cost of 3 and 25000 power from your energy, and reduce the total [Ki] of your Battle Area by 2: Add this card in a Battle Area to your energy in Rest Mode. Then, play the card chosen by this skill with its base skills negated for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-057.name: Goku Black
FB11-057.text:
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Remove a total of 2 or more [Ki] from your Battle Area: Play up to 1 <Goku Black> with a cost of 3 or less from your energy. Then, choose all <Goku Black> in your Battle Area and they get +5000 power for the turn for each [Ki] removed by this skill.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-058.name: Goku Black
FB11-058.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

FB11-059.name: Gowasu
FB11-059.text:
[On Play] If you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, add up to 1 <Goku Black> or <Zamasu> with a cost of 3 or less from your Drop to your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-060.name: Gowasu
FB11-060.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB11-061.name: Zamasu
FB11-061.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[Permanent] If your Leader is <Goku Black> and you have a total of 2 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, this card can't be KO'd once per turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: My Leader is <Goku Black>, I have this card and 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 in my Battle Area, and those Battle Cards have 1 [Ki] each. If my opponent activates their FB01-140 <Son Gohan : Childhood> [On Play] skill, will this card be KO'd?

FB11-062.name: Zamasu
FB11-062.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Goku Black>, look at 4 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Goku Black> or up to 1 card with 《Supreme Kai》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

FB11-063.name: Zamasu
FB11-063.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Goku Black>, choose up to 1 <Goku Black> in your Battle Area and it gets +1 [Ki]. Then, both this card and the card chosen by this skill can't be KO'd until the end of your opponent's next turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: With this card's [On Play] skill, "both this card and the card chosen by this skill can't be KO'd until the end of your opponent's next turn." is applied. If my opponent chooses to KO this card on my opponent's next turn with my opponent's FB02-089 <Son Gohan : Future> [End of Your Turn] skill, will this card be KO'd?

FB11-064.name: Cell
FB11-064.text:
[When KO'd] Discard 1 card from your hand: If you have 4 or less energy, play this card from it's owner's Drop.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] If your Leader is <Giblet>, place any number of cards from your energy to your Drop. Then, add up to 1 green Extra from your Drop to your hand.

FB11-065.name: Zen-Oh
FB11-065.text: [On Play] Choose up to 2 Battle Cards with costs of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO them.

FB11-066.name: Son Goku
FB11-066.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

FB11-067.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FB11-067.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Master's Teachings》 in its special traits, this card gets +2 [Ki].
[When Attacking] Place 1 of your energy into its owner's Drop and reduce the [Ki] of this card by 2: Add the top card of your deck to your energy.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-068.name: Son Gohan : Youth/Piccolo
FB11-068.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Master's Teachings》 in its special traits, choose up to 2 Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and 《Master's Teachings》 in their special traits in your Battle Area and they get +1 [Ki]. Then, the chosen cards can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills until the end of your opponent's next turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-069.name: Piccolo
FB11-069.text:
[Permanent] If your card with 《Master's Teachings》 in its special traits and <Son Gohan> in its card name is removed from a Battle Area by your opponent, you may KO this card in a Battle Area instead.
[On Play] Play up to 1 card with a cost of 2 or less and <Son Gohan> in its card name from your hand. Then, that card gets +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I have a total of 3 cards in my Battle Area: 2 <Son Gohan : Youth> with a cost of 1 and this card. My opponent is attempting to KO my 3 Battle Cards in my Battle Area by activating their FB01-140 <Son Gohan : Childhood> [On Play] skill, and I want to use this card's [Permanent] skill to KO this card instead. What will happen?
qa.a: This card will be KO'd and your 2 <Son Gohan : Youth> cards will remain in the Battle Area.

FB11-071.name: Beautiful Calamity
FB11-071.text:
[Activate Battle][Your Turn] Your card that's in a battle gets +15000 power for the battle. Then, if you have a <Goku Black> with 1 or more [Ki] in your Battle Area, your card that's in a battle gets +10000 power for the battle.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-072.name: The Zero Mortal Project
FB11-072.text:
[Activate Main] Reduce the [Ki] of your Battle Area by 1: Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-073.name: Shallot/Giblet
FB11-073.text:
[Auto] When this card is placed in your Leader Area, you can't play cards with a cost of 4 or less and [Evolve] for the game.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 5 or less, flip this card over.

back.name: Shallet
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] If you have <Shallot> and <Giblet> in your Battle Area, switch 2 of your energy to Active Mode. Then, you can't play Battle Cards with original costs of 4 or less for the turn.

qa.q: This card is my Leader and I have activated the [Auto] skill on its front side. Can I play FS11-06 <Son Goku> without activating its [Evolve] skill on the next turn after my opponent plays FP-079 <Gogeta : Br> and activated its [On Play] skill?
qa.a: Yes, you can. However, after declaring to play FS11-06 <Son Goku> as a card with a cost of 5, it will fail to be played with a cost of 4, and will be placed in its owner's Drop.

FB11-074.name: Whis
FB11-074.text: [Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)

FB11-076.name: Gokua
FB11-076.text:
[Permanent] If your Leader has 2 or less [Ki], this card can't attack.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If your Leader has 《Boujack Brigade》 in its special traits, add up to 1 Battle Card other than <Gokua> with a cost of 2 or less from your Drop to your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-077.name: Goku Black
FB11-077.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB11-078.name: Zahha
FB11-078.text: [Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB11-079.name: Zahha
FB11-079.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2): <Zahha>
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)

FB11-080.name: Zangya
FB11-080.text:
[On Play] Your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
[When KO'd][Your Turn] If your Leader has 《Boujack Brigade》 in its special traits, choose up to 1 of your <Boujack> Leaders or up to 1 <Boujack> in your Battle Area, switch it to Active Mode, and negate the base skills of the chosen card for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

FB11-081.name: Giblet
FB11-081.text:
[Permanent] If you have <Shallot> but not <Giblet> in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[On Play] Choose up to 2 Battle Cards with costs of 4 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and switch them to Rest Mode.

FB11-082.name: Giblet
FB11-082.text:
[Permanent] If you have <Shallot> but not <Giblet> in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

FB11-083.name: Giblet
FB11-083.text:
[Permanent] If you have <Shallot> but not <Giblet> in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Switch 1 <Shallot> in your Battle Area to Rest Mode: Your Leader gets +5000 power for the turn.

FB11-084.name: Giblet
FB11-084.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Giblet> with a cost of 2
[When Attacking] If your Leader is <Shallot/Giblet> or <Shallet>, choose up to 1 Rest Mode Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it can't switch to Active Mode during your opponent's next turn.

FB11-085.name: Shallot
FB11-085.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Shallot/Giblet> or <Shallet>, add up to 1 <Giblet> with a cost of 2 from your Drop to your hand.

[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[End of Your Turn] Add 1 card from your life to your hand.

FS11-04.name: Son Goku

FS11-06.name: Son Goku

FS11-07.name: Son Goku
FS11-07.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2): <Son Goku>

qa.q: I activated this card's [Activate Main] skill, switched it to Active Mode, and used [Evolve] to play FS11-06 <Son Goku> from my hand on top of this card. Will FS11-06 <Son Goku> be placed into my Drop at the end of the turn?

FS11-08.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FS11-08.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku>, draw 1 card.

FS11-09.text:

[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku>, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Videl> or up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Saiyan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

qa.a: They will remain as they were prior to activating [Awaken].

qa.a: It indicates the [Ki] under your Leader or in your Battle Area.

SB02-043.text: [When Attacking][Once per turn] Draw 1 card. Then, if your Leader has 《Planet Namek》 in its special traits and your life is at 3 or less, add up to 1 card from your hand to the top or bottom of your life.

SB02-044.name: Bulma
SB02-044.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Planet Namek》 in its special traits, add 1 card from your life to your energy in Rest Mode. Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to the bottom of your life.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Planet Namek》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, add up to 1 card from your hand to the bottom of your life." part of this card's [On Play] skill?

SB02-045.name: Vegeta
SB02-045.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Planet Namek》 in its special traits, add 1 card from your life to your hand.
[When Attacking] If a card is removed from your life during this turn, this card gets +5000 power for the battle.

qa.q: After using the [When Attacking] skill of SB02-039 <Son Gohan : Youth> to add a card from my life to my hand and then add a card from my hand to my life, if I then play this card, will this meet the conditions for the "if a card is removed from your life during this turn" part of its [When Attacking] skill?

SB02-046.name: Vegeta
SB02-046.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

SB02-047.name: Angry Kamehameha
SB02-047.text: [Activate Battle][Your Turn] If a card is removed from your life during this turn, your card that's in a battle gets +30000 power for the battle.

qa.q: After using the [When Attacking] skill of SB02-039 <Son Gohan : Youth> to add a card from my life to my hand and then add a card from my hand to my life, if I then use this card, will this meet the conditions for the "if a card is removed from your life during this turn" part of its [Activate Battle] skill?

SB02-048.name: Solar Flare!!!!
SB02-048.text: [Activate Main] Draw 1 card. Then, if a card is removed from your life during this turn, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

qa.q: After using the [When Attacking] skill of SB02-039 <Son Gohan : Youth> to add a card from my life to my hand and then add a card from my hand to my life, if I then use this card, will this meet the conditions for the "if a card is removed from your life during this turn" part of its [Activate Main] skill?

SB02-049.name: Ginyu
SB02-049.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] Reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 1 for each card with 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits in your Battle Area.
[End of Your Turn] If this card in a Battle Area is in Rest Mode, place it into its owner's Drop. Then, play up to 1 <Ginyu> with a cost of 1 from your Drop.

qa.q: If I have 2 cards with 《Frieza's Army》 in their special traits in my Battle Area, can I use the [On Play] skill of FB01-132 <Recoome> to play this card from my hand?
If this card is in Active Mode, do I still resolve the "Then, play up to 1 <Ginyu> with a cost of 1 from your Drop" part of this card's [End of Your Turn] skill?

SB02-050.name: Guldo
SB02-050.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits, add 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, choose up to 2 Battle Cards in your opponent's Battle Area and switch them to Rest Mode.

qa.q: If my Leader does not have 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits, do I still resolve the "Then, choose up to 2 Battle Cards in your opponent's Battle Area and switch them to Rest Mode" part of this card's [On Play] skill?

SB02-051.name: Zarbon
SB02-051.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[End of Your Turn] If this card in a Battle Area is in Rest Mode, place it into its owner's Drop.

SB02-052.name: Dodoria
SB02-052.text: [When Attacking] If your Leader has 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits and you have 3 or more cards with 《Frieza's Army》 in their special traits in your Battle Area, draw 1 card.

SB02-053.name: Frieza
SB02-053.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits, play up to 1 non-<Frieza> Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and 《Frieza's Army》 in its special traits from your hand.

SB02-054.name: Frieza
SB02-054.text:
[Permanent] If your Leader is <Frieza> and your non-<Frieza> Battle Card would be removed from a Battle Area by an opponent's skill, you may switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode instead.
[On Play] Draw 1 card.

SB02-055.name: Cymbal
SB02-055.text:
[Permanent][Opponent's Turn] If your Leader is <King Piccolo>, your <King Piccolo> can't be removed from the Battle Area by your opponent's skills.
[On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Demon Clan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

SB02-056.name: Mercenary Tao
SB02-056.text:
[On Play] Place 1 card from your hand on top of its owner's deck : Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.
[When Attacking] Place the top 4 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.

qa.q: Do I always have to activate this card's [On Play] skill?
qa.a: No, you do not. Activating this skill requires paying its skill cost of "Place 1 card from your hand on top of its owner's deck", so you can choose not to pay it.

SB02-057.name: Drum
SB02-057.text: [When Attacking/When KO'd] If your Leader is <King Piccolo>, draw 1 card.

SB02-058.name: King Piccolo
SB02-058.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <King Piccolo> and you don't have an energy marker, you place 1 energy marker. Then, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand and play up to 1 <Demon's Egg> from your hand or Drop.

SB02-059.name: General Blue
SB02-059.text:
[Permanent] This card can't be attacked by Leaders or Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less.
[When Attacking] Place the top 2 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop.

SB02-060.name: Red Ribbon Robot
SB02-060.text:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.
[Activate Main] Place 1 Battle Card from your Battle Area into its owner's Drop : Place the top 3 cards of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, negate the skills of this card in a Battle Area for the turn.

qa.q: If I activate this card's [Activate Main] skill, will its [Permanent] skill be negated?

ST01-001.name: Son Goten
ST01-001.text:
[Auto] When this card is placed in your Leader Area, play up to 1 <Fate Transcending Generations> from your deck.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) If this card has 3 or more [Ki], flip this card over.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

back.name: Son Goten
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[End of Your Turn] If you have used an Extra that has <Kamehameha> in its card name during this turn, choose up to 1 <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area and switch it to Active Mode.

qa.q: What is the exact time at which the "When this card is placed in your Leader Area" part of this card's [Auto] skill on its front side is resolved?
qa.a: It is resolved before shuffling your deck, prior to the start of the game, after both players have revealed their Leader, placed them in their owner's Leader Area, and chosen who goes first.

qa.q: If both players have this card as their Leader, which player will resolve the [Auto] skill on this card's front side first?
qa.a: The player going first will resolve it before the other player.

ST01-002.name: Krillin
ST01-002.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 3 or more [Ki], add up to 1 red <Son Gohan : Adolescence> with a cost of 4 or less from your Drop to your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-004.name: Son Goku
ST01-004.text:
[On Play] Your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
[Auto] If your Leader is <Son Goten> or <Son Gohan : Adolescence>, when this card in a Battle Area is switched to Rest Mode by one of your skills, choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -25000 power for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-005.name: Son Goten
ST01-005.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] If your <Son Goten> or <Son Gohan : Adolescence> Leader has 3 or more [Ki], this card in a Battle Area gets +15000 power.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-006.name: Son Goten
ST01-006.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goten> or <Son Gohan : Adolescence>, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with <Kamehameha> or <Son> in its card name and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

ST01-007.name: Son Goten
ST01-007.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

ST01-008.name: Son Goten/Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-008.text:
[On Play] Discard 1 card from your hand: Play up to 1 <Son Goku> with a cost of 2 from your Drop.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Switch 1 <Son Goku> with a cost of 2 in your Battle Area to Rest Mode: Draw 1 card. Then, this card can attack Active Mode Battle Cards in your opponent's Battle Area during this turn.

ST01-009.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-009.text:
[On Play] If you have <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
[Activate Battle][Your Turn][Once Per Turn] If you have used an Extra that has <Kamehameha> in its card name during this turn, this card that's in a battle gets +15000 power for the battle.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I played this card after using an FS01-16 . Will the "If you have used an Extra that has  in its card name during this turn" condition be fulfilled when the [Activate Battle] skill is activated?

ST01-010.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-010.text:
[Blocker] (After an opponent's attack, you may switch this card to Rest Mode and change the target of the attack to this card.)
[On Play] If you have <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 [Ki]. Then, draw 1 card and discard 1 card from your hand.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-011.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-011.text:
[On Play] Your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] If you have used an Extra that has <Kamehameha> in its card name this turn, switch this card in a Battle Area to Active Mode.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I played this card after using an FS01-16 . Will the "If you have used an Extra that has  in its card name during this turn" condition be fulfilled when the [Activate Main] skill is activated?

ST01-012.name: Trunks : Youth
ST01-012.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 3 or more [Ki], choose your <Son Goten> Leader or up to 1 <Son Goten> in your Battle Area and it gets +10000 power for the turn.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-013.name: Trunks : Youth
ST01-013.text:
[When KO'd] Draw 1 card. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
[Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode: If you have <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-014.name: Videl
ST01-014.text:
[Critical] (When this card inflicts damage with an attack, the life is placed in the Drop.)
[On Play] If you have <Fate Transcending Generations> in your Battle Area, your Leader gets +1 [Ki].
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-015.name: Family Kamehameha
ST01-015.text:
[Activate Battle][Your Turn] Remove all 5 or more [Ki] from your <Son Goten> Leader: Your <Son Goten> Battle Card or <Son Gohan : Adolescence> Battle Card that's in a battle gets +10000 power for the turn for each [Ki] removed by this skill. Then, during this turn, the next time your card KO's your opponent's Battle Card in battle, deal 2 damage to your opponent.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

qa.q: I attacked my opponent's Battle Card with my , and used this card during the battle. Will the "Then, during this turn, the next time your card KO's your opponent's Battle Card in battle, deal 2 damage to your opponent." part of the card effect be resolved?

ST01-016.name: Kamehameha
ST01-016.text: [Activate Battle] If your Leader is <Son Goten> or <Son Gohan : Adolescence>, your card that's in a battle gets +20000 power for the battle. Then, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with a cost of 5 or less and 《Saiyan》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

ST01-017.name: Fate Transcending Generations
ST01-017.text:
[Field] (This card remains in your Battle Area until you place another [Field].)
[Permanent] During a battle, when you would pay the cost of an Extra with <Kamehameha> in its card name from your hand with a cost less than or equal to the [Ki] under your Leader, you may switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode instead.
([Ki]: An energy marker placed under a card.)

ST01-018.name: Kibito
ST01-018.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Potara》 in its special traits, place 2 cards from the top of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn](1): If there are no cards under this card in your Battle Area, and you have <Shin> and <Potara> in your Drop, place 1 <Shin> and 1 <Potara> from your Drop under this card.

ST01-019.name: Kibito Kai
ST01-019.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(0): <Shin> or <Kibito> with a <Potara> under them.
[On Play] If this card was played by an [Evolve] skill, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 2 cards with 《Potara》 in their special traits and add them to your hand. Place the rest into its owner's Drop.

ST01-020.name: Gotenks
ST01-020.text:
[On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.
[Activate Main] Place this card from a Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If your Leader is <Vegito>, play up to 1 <Gotenks> with a cost of 2 and 20000 power from your Drop.

ST01-021.name: Gotenks
ST01-021.text:
[When Attacking] If your Leader is <Vegito>, place 5 cards from the top of your deck into their owner's Drop. Then, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.
[When KO'd] Add up to 1 blue card with a cost of 4 or less other than <Gotenks> from your Drop to your hand.

ST01-022.name: Shin
ST01-022.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has 《Potara》 in its special traits, place 2 cards from the top of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn](1): If there are no cards under this card in your Battle Area, and you have <Kibito> and <Potara> in your Drop, place 1 <Kibito> and 1 <Potara> from your Drop under this card.

ST01-023.name: Son Goku
ST01-023.text:
[On Play] Place 2 cards from the top of your deck into their owner's Drop.
[Activate Main](1), discard 1 card from your hand and place this card from a Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If your Leader is <Vegito>, play up to 1 <Son Goku> with a cost of 3 from your Drop.

ST01-024.name: Son Goku/Vegeta
ST01-024.text:
[Auto] If your Leader is <Vegito>, when this card is played or placed from your deck into its owner's Drop, add up to 1 card with a cost of 6 or less and 《Potara》 in its special traits from your Drop to your hand.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] If this card was played this turn, place 3 cards from the top of your deck into their owner's Drop.

ST01-025.name: Vegito
ST01-025.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Son Goku/Vegeta> with a cost of 3, or <Son Goku> or <Vegeta> with a <Potara> under them.
[On Play] Choose up to 1 of your <Vegito> Leaders and it gets +5000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST01-026.name: I Call This Version...Super Vegito!
ST01-026.text:
[Activate Main] If you have 20 or more cards in your Drop, choose all <Vegito> cards with 40000 power in your Leader Area and in your Battle Area, and they gain [Double Strike] for the turn. Then, at the end of the turn, place all cards from your Drop at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.
([Double Strike]: This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)

ST01-027.name: Majin Buu/Majin Buu : Pure Evil
ST01-027.text:
[Auto] When this card is placed in your Leader Area, play up to 1 <Demonic Maze> from your deck.
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] (Can be activated during [Activate Main/Battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 4 or less, flip this card over.

back.name: Majin Buu : Evil
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card. Then, this card gets +5000 power for the battle.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] If you have 5 or less energy, during this turn, reduce the cost of the next [Evolve] skill you activate on a card with 《Majin》 in its special traits and a cost of 6 or less in your hand by (1).

qa.q: What is the exact time at which the "When this card is placed in your Leader Area" part of this card's [Auto] skill on its front side is resolved?
qa.a: It is resolved before shuffling your deck, prior to the start of the game, after both players have revealed their Leader, placed them in their owner's Leader Area, and chosen who goes first.

qa.q: If both players have this card as their Leader, which player will resolve the [Auto] skill on this card's front side first?
qa.a: The player going first will resolve it before the other player.

ST01-028.name: Majin Buu
ST01-028.text: [On Play] Add 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, look at 1 card from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Majin》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of its owner's deck.

ST01-029.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-029.text: [On Play] Add 1 card from your life to your hand: If your Leader has 《Majin》 in its special traits, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

ST01-030.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-030.text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 2 cards from your hand.

ST01-031.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-031.text: [On Play] If your Leader has 《Majin》 in its special traits, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with 《Majin》 in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of their owner's deck in a random order.

ST01-032.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-032.text:
[Super Combo] (A maximum of 4 cards with [Super Combo] can be placed in a deck.)
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

ST01-033.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-033.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2.
[On Play] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

ST01-034.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-034.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2.
[On Play] Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 1 and 《Majin》 in its special traits from your hand.

ST01-035.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-035.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2.
[Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Choose 1 <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 3 under a <Demonic Maze> in your Battle Area: Switch this card in a Battle Area to Active Mode. Then, play the card chosen by this skill on top of this card.

ST01-036.name: Majin Buu : Evil
ST01-036.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2 or 3.
[On Play] Place 1 card from under a card with 《Majin》 in its special traits in your Battle Area into its owner's Drop: If you have 3 or more energy, play up to 1 <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2 from your hand. Then, you can't play <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 2 for the turn.

ST01-037.name: Majin Buu : Kid
ST01-037.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 3 or 4.
[On Play] Place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin》 in their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop: Draw 2 cards.

qa.q: Will the "Place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin、Ein their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop" condition for this card's [On Play] skill be fulfilled by, for example, placing a total of 3 cards, consisting of 2 cards from under this card and 1 card from under an ST01-042  in a Battle Area, into their owner's Drop?

ST01-038.name: Majin Buu : Kid
ST01-038.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(2): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 3 or 4.
[On Play] Add cards from the top of your deck to your life until you have 3 life. Then, you may place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin》 in their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop. If you do, switch this card to Active Mode and it gets +15000 power for the turn.

qa.q: Will the "you may place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin、Ein their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop" condition for this card's [On Play] skill be fulfilled by, for example, placing a total of 3 cards, consisting of 2 cards from under this card and 1 card from under an ST01-042  in a Battle Area, into their owner's Drop?
If I play this card when my life is at 4, how will the "Add cards from the top of your deck to your life until you have 3 life." part of its [On Play] skill be resolved?
qa.a: In that case, your life will remain unchanged.

qa.q: If I play this card when my life is at 4, will the "you may place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin、Ein their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop. If you do, switch this card to Active Mode and it gets +15000 power for the turn." part of its [On Play] skill be resolved?

ST01-039.name: Majin Buu : Kid
ST01-039.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Majin Buu : Evil> with a cost of 3 or 4.
[On Play] Place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin》 in their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop: Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 5 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

qa.q: Will the "Place a total of 3 cards from under cards with 《Majin、Ein their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop" condition for this card's [On Play] skill be fulfilled by, for example, placing a total of 3 cards, consisting of 2 cards from under this card and 1 card from under an ST01-042  in a Battle Area, into their owner's Drop?

ST01-040.name: Majin Buu : Pure Evil
ST01-040.text: [Activate Main][Once Per Turn] Discard 1 card from your hand: Draw 1 card.

ST01-041.name: Majin Buu : Pure Evil
ST01-041.text: [Activate Main][Once Per Turn] KO 1 <Majin Buu> in your Battle Area: This card in a Battle Area gets +15000 power for the turn.

ST01-042.name: Demonic Maze
ST01-042.text:
[Field] (This card remains in your Battle Area until you place another [Field].)
[Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode and place 1 Battle Card with 《Majin》 in its special traits from your Drop under this card: Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

ST01-043.name: Irrational Destructive Impulse
ST01-043.text: [Activate Main] Place a total of 2 cards from under cards with 《Majin》 in their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop: If you have a Battle Card with a cost of 6 or more and 《Majin》 in its special traits in your Battle Area, choose all Battle Cards with a cost of 3 or less in the Battle Areas and KO them.

qa.q: Will the "Place a total of 2 cards from under cards with 《Majin、Ein their special traits in your Battle Area into their owner's Drop" condition for this card's [Activate Main] skill be fulfilled by, for example, placing a total of 2 cards, consisting of 1 card from under an ST01-038  and 1 card from under an ST01-042  in your Battle Area, into their owner's Drop?

ST01-044.name: Son Goku
ST01-044.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Son Goku> with 《Another World》 in its special traits.
[Auto] When an opponent's Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less attacks, you may switch this Rest Mode card in a Battle Area to Active Mode. If you do, change the target of the attack to this card.

ST01-045.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-045.text: [Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode: If you have a Battle Card with a cost of 4 or more in your Battle Area, draw 1 card.

ST01-046.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
ST01-046.text:
[Evolve] (You may pay the skill cost and play on top of the specified card in a Battle Area)(1): <Son Gohan : Adolescence> with a cost of 2 or less.
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku>, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, switch this card to Active Mode.

ST01-047.name: Paragus
ST01-047.text:
[When KO'd] Draw 1 card.
[Activate Main] Switch this card in a Battle Area to Rest Mode: If your Leader is <Broly>, and you have a Battle Card with a cost of 4 or more and <Broly> in its card name in your Battle Area, choose up to 1 Rest Mode Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area, and it can't switch to Active Mode during your opponent's next turn.

ST01-048.name: Broly
ST01-048.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Broly>, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 <Kakarot> or up to 1 card with <Broly> in its card name, and add it to your hand. qa.q: If both players have this card as their Leader, which player will resolve the [Auto] skill on this card's front side first?
